verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe fetched https://docs.agentmail.to/openapi.json with HTTP 200, and the file contains an "openapi" key. That confirms a downloadable, machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly served from the product's docs site. The llms.txt probe adds a second machine-readable docs artifact. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that points users to the spec, and evidence that the spec covers the full API surface (version and completeness are unverified).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.agentmail.to/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
